Super organized at well-funded talaga etong naka ambang na INC Rally for Peace and Transparency and Accountability sa November 16-18 kuno.

Aside sa magandang t-shirt at pamimigay neto, baka pwede namang i-apply sa sarili nyo yang panawagan nyo — be transparent with your bloc voting practices and how you choose politicians that you endorse which included BBM in 2022 and many Senators implicated in the flood control scandal now.

Tapos baka pwede din po kayo maging accountable sa consequences ng endorsement nyo kay Sara Duterte dahil sya ay nag lulustay ng pera ng taumbayan from confidential funds to her frequent travels.

Thank you po. Peace be with you. 🙏

Sana hindi umulan sa Sunday. 😇
